item.title: [The Verge] Android app developers will soon have to share their address publicly
item.description: Independent Android app developers are worried about their privacy after Google announced that from next year many of them will be required to share a phone number and address publicly. The policy change is intended to meet European Union regulations under the Digital Services Act, but Google says contact details will be made public worldwide. […]
